subject: Anchored POC: top-up credits vs. extending timebox — proposal and next steps
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Klein <sofia.klein@asterhealth.com>
Cc: AsterHealth Procurements <procurements@asterhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Anchored POC: top-up credits vs. extending timebox — initial proposal

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, I pulled together two practical paths to keep your timeboxed POC on-track while giving you runway for the expanded integrations you mentioned (HL7 ingestion + multi-model experiments):

Option A — Top-up credits (preferred for velocity)
- 200k extra tokens (applies to model runtime) delivered as refundable "top-up" credits.
- 2 weeks of accelerated onboarding (priority engineering queue, weekly syncs) included.
- No change to contract duration. Credits expire 90 days after delivery.
- Price: $14,000 (net) with standard T&Cs; we can guitar-match finance for a small volume rebate if conversion to a committed plan happens within 60 days.

Option B — Timebox extension (preferred for procurement simplicity)
- +4 weeks to the existing 8-week POC (same throughput/burst profile).
- Includes standard onboarding (no priority queue).
- Price: $11,500 (net).

Key differences: credits let you ramp experiments now (no rework of deployment), extension buys calendar time but pushes the conversion decision later.

If helpful, I can provide a side-by-side total-cost summary and a one-page SOW amendment for either path. What would procurement need from us to accelerate decisioning this week?

Attaching a short proposal and a draft SOW for review.

Attachments: POC_TopUp_Proposal_v2.pdf, SOW-draft.docx

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0178
From: Sofia Klein <sofia.klein@asterhealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 08:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Anchored POC: top-up credits vs. extending timebox — initial proposal

Hi Olga —

Thanks for the clear options — good to see the rapid onboarding offering. A couple quick Qs from our side before we loop Procurement formally: 

1) If we take Option A (credits), can unused credits roll into a committed conversion (i.e., convert to prepay without losing value)?
2) Is there any flexibility on the price for Option B if we commit to a 6-month pilot conversion roadmap (we're quite likely to convert but need to show spend vs. outcomes to finance)?
3) The accelerated onboarding: how many engineering hours are included and will this require a new SOW?

Procurement asked for a single-line comparison they can put in the PO — if you can provide that and confirm whether your legal prefers an amendment or a short addendum, we can move quickly.

Sofia Klein
Head of Integrations | AsterHealth
sofia.klein@asterhealth.com
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Anchored POC: top-up credits vs. extending timebox — procurement asks

Team — forwarding Sofia's questions. Quick ask: can we structure an offer that keeps velocity while limiting discount? Proposed structure below — want to confirm finance/legal appetite before I reply to AsterHealth.

Proposal (recommended):
- Offer A (Top-up + onboarding): 200k credits + 2 weeks priority onboarding (equivalent to ~24 engineering hours). Price $13,000 net (7% discount off list $14k).
- Conversion protection: Any unused credits can be applied at 90% value toward a 6-month conversion prepayment within 45 days of POC end (expires otherwise).
- Offer B (Time extension + standard onboarding): +4 weeks for $10,500 net (9% discount).
- Managed services alternative: instead of extra discount, offer up to 12 hours of remediation/ops support at no charge if they choose Offer B.

Rationale: A keeps them moving; small discount signals partnership but protects margin. Conversion protection gives procurement comfort.

Can finance approve these net prices and the credit-conversion mechanic? Priyom — legal question: do we prefer an amendment or a short addendum for these changes (simple credit clause vs contract duration extension)?

Thanks,
Olga
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Anchored POC: top-up credits vs. extending timebox — procurement asks

Olga —

Finance is comfortable with the proposed net prices for a one-off POC concession (13k and 10.5k). We'd like to cap the total concession budget per account; please note this will be the discretionary credit for AsterHealth.

Legal (quick take): prefer an addendum to the existing MSA that references the original SOW and specifies: "Top-up credits deliverable and expiry; credits convertible at 90% of value toward a defined conversion prepayment if conversion agreement executed within 45 days post-POC." This keeps procurement paperwork tight and avoids rewriting the MSA. I'll draft the clause and circulate.

Also — recommend structuring the DocuSign as two checkboxes (Offer A or Offer B) and a signature line so Procurement can choose cleanly.

-Marissa (looping in for deal approval)
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Klein <sofia.klein@asterhealth.com>
Cc: AsterHealth Procurements <procurements@asterhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Anchored POC: top-up credits vs. extending timebox — final offer and next steps

Sofia / Procurement team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Based on internal alignment, here's the formalized two-option offer (DocuSign link and one-line PO-ready summary below). Please let me know which option you prefer and we'll push the addendum + invoice.

One-line comparison for PO: 
- Option A (Top-up + priority onboarding): 200k runtime credits + 2 weeks priority onboarding; price $13,000 net. Unused credits convertible at 90% toward a 6-month conversion prepay if executed within 45 days after POC end.
- Option B (4-week extension): +4 calendar weeks to POC; price $10,500 net. Includes up to 12 hours of remediation/ops support.

DocuSign for selection: https://app.docusign.com/link/asterhealth-poc-offer-DL-2026-0891
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/DL-2026-0891
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Asterlink

Attachments: POC_TopUp_Proposal_v2.pdf, SOW-draft.docx

Next steps:
1) Procurement reviews and chooses checkbox on DocuSign (Option A or B).
2) If Option A chosen, we deliver credits and schedule onboarding kickoff within 48 hours of signed DocuSign.
3) If Option B chosen, we issue amended SOW and schedule the standard onboarding session.

Happy to jump on a 15-min call to walk Procurement through the PO line if that helps.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
